description: Unit tests for the Windows DHCP PAC file fetcher in Chromium, testing various scenarios including fetching, cancellation, timeouts, and reuse of fetcher instances.

classes.name: RealFetchTester
classes.description: Helper class to perform and manage DHCP PAC file fetch tests, including cancellation and deferred cancellation scenarios.

classes.name: DelayingDhcpPacFileAdapterFetcher
classes.description: A mock fetcher that delays DHCP queries to simulate network latency.

classes.name: DelayingDhcpPacFileFetcherWin
classes.description: A mock DHCP fetcher that creates delayed adapter fetchers for testing deferred cancellation.

classes.name: DummyDhcpPacFileAdapterFetcher
classes.description: A dummy fetcher used for testing, configurable to simulate different fetch results and delays.

classes.name: MockDhcpPacFileFetcherWin
classes.description: A mock implementation of the DHCP fetcher for testing various adapter scenarios and fetcher behaviors.

classes.name: FetcherClient
classes.description: A helper class to run fetch tests, handle completion, and manage fetcher state.

methods.name: RunTest
methods.description: Initiates a fetch operation and sets up completion callback.

methods.name: RunTestWithCancel
methods.description: Performs a fetch operation and cancels it immediately.

methods.name: RunTestWithDeferredCancel
methods.description: Performs a fetch operation with a delayed cancel to test deferred cancellation.

methods.name: FinishTestAllowCleanup
methods.description: Allows worker threads to finish, with a sleep delay.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures dummy fetcher with specific result, delay, and script.
